gaps.sentence: There is little ___ that the plan will be approved.
gaps.hint: pattern: little ___ that something will happen
gaps.explanation: 'Possibility that ...' is the standard pattern; 'opportunity' means a situation that lets you do something.

gaps.sentence: He ___ her on her presentation and her handling of questions.
Be careful not to ___ your passport at the check-in desk.
gaps.explanation: 'Lose' is the verb; 'loose' means not tight.

gaps.sentence: The two brothers are ___ in appearance but not in character.
gaps.explanation: 'They are alike' — 'alike' follows the verb and cannot come before a noun.

gaps.sentence: The consultant will ___ us on every stage of the merger.
gaps.explanation: 'Advise' is the verb; 'advice' is the noun.

gaps.sentence: I couldn't ___ what he was saying because of the noise.
gaps.explanation: 'Hear' means to receive sound; 'listen' means to pay attention deliberately and needs 'to'.

gaps.sentence: One of the screws on the bracket has come ___.
The train ___ was delayed by two hours.
gaps.hint: the act of travelling from A to B, especially by land or rail
gaps.explanation: 'Journey' is an act of travelling from one place to another; 'voyage' is by sea; 'travel' is uncountable.
